parsed.doc_summary: LAHD RSO rent increase calculator page: states the 3% annual allowable increase for July 1, 2025–June 30, 2026, ends the utility pass-through on Feb 2, 2026, and describes RSO/SCEP surcharge pass-throughs and the state 30-day notice requirement.

rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: For RSO units, the annual allowable rent increase was 3% for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026. Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords can no longer add any extra percentage for utilities. RSO and SCEP surcharges may be passed through only after the unit is registered and written notice is given.
rules.citation: L.A. Mun. Code ch. XV, art. 1 (Rent Stabilization Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.key_value: 3% annual increase (7/1/2025–6/30/2026); no utility add-on from 2/2/2026
rules.effective_date_note: Date the removal of the utility add-on takes effect, per LAHD page; the 3% figure applies from 2025-07-01. Another source (landlord association) has reported 2026-01-24.
rules.coverage_conditions: Units subject to the RSO; check ZIMAS to confirm.
rules.interaction: The state Tenant Protection Act cap does not apply where local rent control is stricter.
rules.conflict_note: Two published effective dates exist for the new formula: 2026-02-02 (LAHD) and 2026-01-24 (landlord association). The 3% figure covers only through 2026-06-30, so the current-year figure is not stated in this document.

unverifiable_exemptions: RSO exemptions such as single-family homes and condos, and units under a certificate of occupancy after 1978

rules.title: State 30-day written notice for rent increases under 10%
rules.requirement: Landlords must give 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
rules.quoted_span: State law requires landlords to provide 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
rules.key_value: 30 days' written notice for increases under 10%
rules.conflict_note: The page does not name the statute; Civ. Code § 827 is inferred and is not stated in the document.
